chemistry-killer-07.title: Mol
chemistry-killer-07.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
chemistry-killer-07.material: Standart sharoitda (STP, 0 °C, 1 atm; 1 mol gaz = 22,4 L) metan ($\mathrm{CH_4}$) va karbonat angidrid ($\mathrm{CO_2}$) dan iborat aralashma gazning hajmi 11,2 L va massasi 16,4 g. Atom massalari H=1, C=12, O=16 va Avogadro soni $N_A$. Bu aralashma gazdagi barcha atomlar soni qancha?
chemistry-killer-07.s.s1.prompt: Standart sharoitda (STP, 0 °C, 1 atm; 1 mol gaz = 22,4 L) metan ($\mathrm{CH_4}$) va karbonat angidrid ($\mathrm{CO_2}$) dan iborat aralashma gazning hajmi 11,2 L va massasi 16,4 g. Atom massalari H=1, C=12, O=16 va Avogadro soni $N_A$. Bu aralashma gazdagi barcha atomlar soni qancha?
chemistry-killer-07.s.s1.explain:
1-bosqich: umumiy mol = 11,2 L ÷ 22,4 L/mol = 0,5 mol → x + y = 0,5.
2-bosqich: massa: 16x + 44y = 16,4. y = 0,5 − x ni qo‘yamiz: 16x + 22 − 44x = 16,4 → 28x = 5,6 → x = 0,2, y = 0,3.
3-bosqich: atomlar soni: $\mathrm{CH_4}$ molekulada 5 ta → 0,2 × 5 = 1,0 mol, $\mathrm{CO_2}$ molekulada 3 ta → 0,3 × 3 = 0,9 mol. Yig‘indi 1,9 mol atom = $1.9\,N_A$.
Javob: $1.9\,N_A$ (c). (Noto‘g‘ri javoblar: 1,5 hammasi CO2 deb, 2,5 hammasi CH4 deb faraz qilingan qiymat, 1,7 CH4 atomlarini faqat 4 ta H deb sanagan qiymat)
chemistry-killer-07.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
chemistry-killer-07.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
